Subject: Coord: demo + contract redline session (Acme Robotics)

Hi Priya / Tom —

Thanks for the time last week. Acme sounded ready to move forward and wanted to combine a short technical demo with a coordinated contract redline session so procurement + legal can walk through the SOW/SAAS agreement. Proposed plan:

- 30min product demo (Soojin)
- 45min contract redline / Q&A (Markus + Monica)
- 15min next-steps and signature logistics (Laura + Procurement)

Can you confirm whether next Tuesday 5/11 or Thursday 5/13 works for your team? We can run the session over Zoom and share a Google Drive with pre-reads. I attached a one-page agenda and a short list of contract items we suggest prioritizing.

Attaching: 20270502_acme_agenda.pdf, redline-priorities.docx

If those slots don't work, share two that do and we will adjust.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Monica —

Thanks — this sounds good. Our team prefers 5/13 (Thu) in the afternoon PT. Two slots that would work for us: 1) Thu 5/13 1:00–2:45pm PT or 2) Thu 5/13 3:00–4:45pm PT.

A few asks from procurement/security so we can prepare:
- Can you provide SOC 2 type II report or equivalent evidence and your data retention policy?
- We will need a redline-ready copy of the SOW and the main agreement ahead of the session.
- Please confirm whether Redwood supports SAML SSO and provisioned SCIM.

I’ve looped procurement and our security engineer on this thread. If you can upload the documents to a shared Drive and send a DocuSign prep link, that helps speed review.

Best,

Monica / Priya —

Thanks for the heads up. I’ll be available during the 1:00–2:45pm PT slot on 5/13. To make the session productive, I propose we prioritize the following clauses so the meeting doesn't get bogged down:

1) Data handling & retention (scope, deletion, backup)
2) Audit rights / logs / SOC evidence
3) Liability cap & indemnity carve-outs
4) Security exceptions / export controls

If Acme can flag any specific redline language ahead of time (even a paragraph or clause number), I’ll prepare preferred language and brief rationale. I’ll also add a 1-page legal summary to the Drive folder.

-Markus
